points.description: Core fact: find the node to delete, then replace it with its in-order successor, i.e. the leftmost (minimum) node of its right subtree, or alternatively the in-order predecessor, the rightmost (maximum) node of its left subtree.
points.partial_credit: Half or more (2-3 marks) if the student says to replace with a successor/predecessor or a node from the right or left subtree but is vague or gets leftmost/rightmost wrong; or if they only say find the node and replace it without saying with what.

points.description: States that the first step is to search for/find the node to be deleted in the tree.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the replacement rule: the leftmost node of the right subtree (or rightmost of the left subtree), in any wording such as in-order successor or predecessor, plus finding the node first. Give part marks for a vague or partly wrong replacement, such as naming the right subtree without leftmost or giving only the search step. Give no marks for answers about other operations, such as insertion or traversal, that do not state the replacement idea.
